comments: Pushes large-area electronics into GHz regime; enables passive, energy-efficient wide-scale IoT deployment, though manufacturing scalability for trillion-node systems not yet demonstrated.

model_io.model: 2.4 GHz backscattering systems based on ZnO TFT resonant-switch matrices

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-area electronics cannot operate above ~100 MHz
hypotheses.result: Refuted; TFT resonant-switch architecture enables 2.4 GHz MIMO backscattering systems

title: Dual resonant transmissive circular dichroism in a rotationally transformed chiral metasurface
task: Demonstrate dual-resonant circular dichroism in rotationally-transformed chiral metasurface
key_results: Bilayer chiral metasurface yields dual RHCP CD maxima at 9.672 and 10.636 GHz (0.72 and 0.75) within common transmission window; complete CD null at 10.3 GHz; interlayer coupling and unequal terminal paths enable dual-modal response
comments: Elegant chiral metasurface design for passive circular-polarization-selective reception; geometry-derived equivalent-circuit model validates full-wave response.

model_io.model: Electrically-thin bilayer chiral metasurface (11×11 mm² unit cell)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unequal-arm unit cells with front-back transformation enable dual-resonant CD
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; compound transformation establishes chiral interlayer coupling; second modal contribution from unequal paths
